pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark brown-to-black contiguous regions exhibit complex, stellate and polygonal geometries with highly irregular, jagged perimeters. Sharp pixel-intensity gradients define the boundaries between the patches and the background pelage.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light-colored interstitial space forms a continuous, interconnected topological mesh. Intersections (junction nodes) are frequent, with pathway thickness remaining consistently narrow and uniform across the visible flank and neck regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the neck and upper shoulder presents a jagged 1D silhouette with a high-frequency, low-amplitude serration pattern against the background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct reddish-brown focal region of textural and pigmentary disruption is visible on the mid-posterior flank, diverging from the standard dark-patch color profile.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple small avian organisms (oxpeckers) are visible as dark silhouettes perched along the dorsal ridge of the neck and back.
